title: Preparation of Serotonin and Naloxone Drug Plates
author: Serena Ding
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6y5hfy6

steps.title: Prepare and Label Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare six 35 mm petri dishes, labeling three as serotonin (20 mM) plates and three as naloxone (10 mM) plates.

steps.title: Calculate Drug Weights
steps.instruction: Calculate the required weight of powdered serotonin for 10 mL of agar (20 mM final concentration) and powdered naloxone for 1 mL of 10X stock solution (100 mM, for a 10 mM final concentration).

steps.title: Weigh and Prepare Drug Solutions
steps.instruction: Using an analytical balance inside a fume hood, weigh the required amounts of serotonin and naloxone.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the weighed naloxone powder into a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube labeled with the compound and final concentration.
Add 1 mL sterile water to the naloxone tube to create the 10X stock solution and close the lid.

steps.title: Dissolve Naloxone Stock
steps.instruction: Vortex the naloxone stock solution Eppendorf tube at setting 10 for 30 seconds to ensure the compound is fully dissolved.

steps.title: Prepare Low Peptone NGM Agar
steps.instruction: Prepare 500 mL of low peptone NGM agar and autoclave it.

substeps.instruction: Use 500 mL to ensure chemical weights can be measured accurately.
After the autoclave cycle is complete, add salts as normally required.

steps.title: Cast Serotonin Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare the serotonin agar plates in a fume hood.

substeps.instruction: Remove 10 mL of molten low peptone NGM agar.
Add the pre-weighed serotonin to achieve a 20 mM final concentration and mix well.
Dispense 3 mL of the mixture into each of the three pre-labeled serotonin plates using a 10 mL serological pipette.

steps.title: Cast Naloxone Base Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare the base agar plates for naloxone using a different 10 mL serological pipette.

substeps.instruction: Draw up 10 mL of molten agar (without serotonin).
Dispense 3 mL into each of the three pre-labeled naloxone plates.

steps.title: Diffuse Drugs
steps.instruction: Wrap the drug plates in foil and store them overnight at 4°C to allow the drugs to diffuse.

steps.title: Apply Naloxone Stock
steps.instruction: Apply the naloxone stock solution to the naloxone plates.

substeps.instruction: Add 300 μL of 10X naloxone stock solution on top of each naloxone plate.
Let the plates dry in a laminar flow hood for 3 hours.
